acceptance_status: provisional; gaps found; no independent acquittal
scope: Implementation assumptions and concrete defects only. Reviewed working-tree changes against dc77e779ab9bc96dd28754e71ad30886ba9ee359, primary source files, the spec and ledger. Findings below describe the pre-fix implementation read and reproduced during round 1; the parent began fixes during this review, and those fixes require the requested follow-up review.

undeclared.decision: Resolve explicit extensions exactly; for extensionless imports use a fixed JS/TS/Vue extension and index-file candidate list, reject multiple matches rather than selecting a precedence winner, and apply the longest matching explicit alias prefix. Do not emulate TS extension substitution or project resolver configuration.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The chosen resolver determines whether an otherwise supported static import expands, is ambiguous, or is reported missing. A-004/A-006 do not specify this semantic policy.

undeclared.decision: Use complete source lines and whole declaration/function/class ranges; a variable definition includes its entire VariableDeclaration, including sibling declarators. Traverse all modeled references in those excerpts. Merge adjacent ranges and count usage.seeds/definitions as merged snippets with qualifying reasons, not symbols.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This can introduce unrelated same-line or sibling code into traversal and consume budget. The resulting usage fields must not be read as definition counts or retrieval success. A-002/A-007 do not fully declare the excerpt unit and usage interpretation.

undeclared.decision: Omit type-only references and parameter bindings from enrichment, and silently omit unbound names instead of producing one unresolved entry per name. The unresolved array inventories only recognized unsupported/omitted relationships.
undeclared.why_it_matters: An empty unresolved array cannot establish that all referenced definitions were found. This limitation is described in new documentation but not in the assumption ledger.

undeclared.decision: Treat Vue normal script and script-setup as independent scopes; expose exports only from normal script, always report template/cross-block relationships as unmodeled, and reject enrichment of the entire Vue file when an external template, custom block, external script or unsupported script language is encountered.
undeclared.why_it_matters: These choices narrow the promised inline Vue-script support and affect which definitions survive even when a usable inline script exists. A-004 does not declare this boundary.

undeclared.decision: A missing/failing/timed-out parser returns a successful seed-only context artifact with gaps; the parser subprocess has a 45-second timeout. No findings avoids starting the parser.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Callers must inspect parser status and unresolved entries rather than treating CLI success as successful enrichment. The ledger gives input bounds but not this fallback interface.

undeclared.decision: Page the serialized full JSON packet; callers must repeat generation options on every page. Cache four option-keyed packets per session with insertion-order eviction.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Options are part of the pagination contract, and changing or omitting them selects another packet. A-008 states pagination/receipts but not these requirements.

undeclared.decision: Default to JSON on stdout; optional output creates a new file, refuses overwrites and candidate-project destinations. Corrected policy must also exclude immutable report-run directories.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The new output command writes outside the source tree, so its destination and overwrite rules are part of the user-visible contract. These rules are not included in A-006.

stale_rows.stated: Lexical definitions and static local named/default ESM imports in JS/TS/Vue; unsupported relationships are gaps.
stale_rows.observed: Round-1 code can falsely export an unexported same-line binding, misresolve computed-method and default-parameter scopes, and silently drop runtime TS enum/namespace declarations. These are implementation contradictions to fix, not behavior to bless in the ledger.

stale_rows.stated: Separate opt-in material; no changes to frozen B/C/D rendering.
stale_rows.observed: Frozen rendering itself is unchanged, but round-1 CLI accepts output inside an immutable run directory, making the whole archived report fail inventory verification. The archive-preservation invariant needs the output guard.

defects.problem: Named-export membership is inferred from overlapping source line numbers, so unrelated declarations on the same line become exports.
defects.observed: Parsed shared.js exports contains both secret and publicValue; enriching main.js line 2 includes secret as an import-definition and returns no gaps.
defects.expected: secret is not exported. Resolve export membership from the declaration AST bindings; report the requested secret export missing.

defects.problem: Computed method keys are visited inside the new method-parameter scope, though the key expression belongs to the enclosing scope.
defects.observed: main.js has no modeled references; enriching line 2 returns only its seed and no gaps.
defects.expected: The computed key resolves to the imported key; the parameter named key only shadows names used inside the method.

defects.problem: Default-parameter initializers incorrectly share the scope that receives body var declarations.
defects.observed: The value reference on line 2 is bound to the body var on line 3 and the imported definition is not returned.
defects.expected: The parameter initializer resolves value in its outer scope; function-body vars are not visible there.

defects.problem: The TS-prefix filter treats runtime enum and namespace constructs as type-only and emits no unsupported-runtime gap.
defects.observed: Both modules report status parsed with empty references and gaps, so a seed using Status or Thing receives no definition or explanation.
defects.expected: Either model those runtime definitions or explicitly register their bindings as unsupported so their uses yield a gap. Do not treat runtime TS statements as type-only.

defects.problem: The new output command can invalidate the verified archive it just read.
defects.reproduction: Scan a temporary project; run reports context REPORT_ID --store STORE --output STORE/runs/REPORT_ID/context.json; then call archive.verify(REPORT_ID, STORE).
defects.observed: Context command exits 0 and writes context.json; verify raises EvidenceError: Archive inventory changed.
defects.expected: Refuse outputs anywhere inside immutable runs directories, in addition to candidate-project and overwrite restrictions. Keep derived artifacts outside immutable run inventories.

defects.problem: Markdown output and the UI copy action discard the source binding and generator identity that SPEC explicitly requires in JSON/Markdown artifacts.
defects.reproduction: Build a normal context packet and render markdown(packet); test whether packet.input_sha256 and packet.generator.implementation_sha256 appear in the result.
defects.observed: Both checks are false. Markdown also omits schema, parser, aliases and full limits/usage metadata.
defects.expected: Render the existing packet metadata, including source binding and generator identity, in Markdown. This needs no new hashes or binding scheme.
